name: Yanagawa Kousuke
source:
Deputy director of Naginata club and a second year high school student. He has a crush on Kosumi Tomoka, but he has a strong will to put their relationship on hold. He joined the Naginata club on the way. He isn't popular because he's not very friendly. He puts Kosumi first.

[Translated from [url=https://sonokoi-horyu.net/character/]official website[/url]]
